dispatch.note: launch is a third roof and is NOT priced here. A key within 3x of the session's own dispatch floor is flagged; its cycles above the arithmetic and traffic roofs are not evidence that a kernel is slow.

refutation.consequence: The pre-registered criterion 'weighted fold seconds must fit inside the 14.881 s bare fold' is what decides whether this replay is a LOWER bound on fold cost. If it fired, at least one arm is running a configuration the fold does not use, so no per-class rate from this session may be quoted as what the fold's shapes can do.
